dashboard.label: SFOS Agent Observability
dashboard.description: The movie of what 11 cron-scheduled SFOS agents are doing. Three streams: Reflexion outcomes (what worked / failed), eval drift (which skills are regressing), and bandit regret (which marketing arms learned). See https://github.com/alex-jb/solo-founder-os/tree/master/solo_founder_os/splunk_obs

search.query: sourcetype="sfos:reflection" earliest=-24h | stats count by agent_dir, outcome | sort -count
sourcetype="sfos:reflection" earliest=-7d (outcome="FAILED" OR outcome="PARTIAL") | head 50 | table _time, agent_dir, task, outcome, verbatim_signal, reflection_text

panel.title: Panel 2 — Eval Drift Over Time (score 1-5, lower = drift)

search.query: sourcetype="sfos:eval" earliest=-60d | timechart span=1d avg(score) as mean_score by skill
sourcetype="sfos:eval" earliest=-60d | stats max(p10) as p10, max(score) as score, latest(n_samples) as n by skill | where score < 2.5 | sort score
sourcetype="sfos:bandit" earliest=-30d | timechart span=1h sum(regret) as period_regret by arm_slug | streamstats sum(period_regret) as cumulative_regret by arm_slug

panel.title: Panel 3b — Top arms by realized reward (7d)

search.query: sourcetype="sfos:bandit" earliest=-7d | stats count as pulls, avg(predicted_reward) as predicted, avg(actual_reward) as actual, sum(regret) as total_regret by arm_slug | sort -actual
